note: Expected tokens of the main document of each canonical, normalize, invalid, sets and hashes case of cases.json, generated by scripts/dbspec/syntax-vectors.mts from the TypeScript analyzeDbspec. A token is [line, start, end, class]: line is 1-based, start and end count code points on the line. A sets case id ends with the 1-based place of its document in documents; a hashes case id ends with the document name. Every runtime must match these tokens exactly.
